v2_accessible_restaurants:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.v2_accessible_restaurants(p_roles text[], p_schedules boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS SETOF uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select m.restaurant_id from public.v2_members m join public.v2_restaurants r on r.id=m.restaurant_id
 where m.user_id=(select auth.uid()) and m.status='activo'
 and not public.v2_is_support_agent() and lower(btrim(m.role))=any(p_roles) and (select public.v2_mfa_session_allowed())
 and public.v2_trial_access_allowed(r.id)
 and (not p_schedules or r.plan_code in ('intermediate','advanced'))
 union
 select distinct g.restaurant_id from public.v2_support_grants g join public.v2_restaurants r on r.id=g.restaurant_id
 where g.agent_id=auth.uid() and g.revoked_at is null and g.expires_at>now()
 and public.v2_support_role(r.id)=any(p_roles) and public.v2_trial_access_allowed(r.id)
 and (not p_schedules or r.plan_code in ('intermediate','advanced'));
$function$
